rationale: The request is a fresh change to an existing user-facing installation guide, and no approved durable UR or Brownfield decision is present. Under the earliest-blocking-gate and fail-closed rules, the next permissible stage is UR; later routing and implementation remain unavailable.
decision_grounds: Task requests clarification of the first installation path in an existing guide.
No approval or Brownfield decision is present.
Missing control state must remain fail-closed.
A fresh change request without an approved durable UR routes to UR.
No delivery path can be evaluated before approved UR and Brownfield Review produce a visible Mode/Slice Decision.
Compact Delivery is ineligible because there is no visible approved UR, completed Brownfield analysis, or stored quick_t
